for row in active:
 folder=root/'slots'/f"{row['sequence']:04d}"
 value['active_files']=[str(x.relative_to(folder)) for x in folder.rglob('*') if x.is_file() and '.sqlite' not in x.name][:60]
 logs=list(folder.glob('collector-*.log'))
 if logs:value['collector_tail']=logs[-1].read_text(errors='replace')[-3000:]
if value['pause'] is not None:raise ValueError('MAIN_PAUSED_RETAIN_REASON')
if counts.get('RUNNING')!=1 or counts.get('PLANNED')!=1498 or counts.get('BACKED_UP')!=1:raise ValueError('ACTUAL_NEXT_ADMISSION_NOT_CONFIRMED')
if active[0]['execution_id']!='01a11705-11f0-7826-bd9d-9066d82c4452' or active[0]['sequence']!=2 or active[0]['arm']!='P1':raise ValueError('SAVED_NEXT_IDENTITY_DRIFT')
if 'ActiveState=active' not in units['fyp-phase8-campaign.service']:raise ValueError('MAIN_SERVICE_NOT_RUNNING')
dep=root.parent/'deployment'
with (dep/'actual-admission-confirmation.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2)
subprocess.run(['systemctl','stop','fyp-p85-continuation-preparation-stop.timer','fyp-p85-continuation-preparation-absolute.timer'],check=True)
print(json.dumps(value))
